normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter has no independent security identity; it only parameterizes the withdrawal amount in withdraw.
The user parameter is only meaningful as the purchase beneficiary handled inside _purchase.
packCount is a transient quantity consumed entirely by the _purchase pricing and recording logic.
The price local exists solely to be forwarded to the vault transfer call.
The id parameter is used only to index the purchases array inside callback.
The random local is computed and immediately stored as p.randomness inside callback.
cardDifference is a transient measure of newly minted cards used only within claimMultiple.
The _owner argument has no separate identity; it is directly assigned to owner in setOwner.
purchaseID only exists to select the purchase passed to the external claim call.
